# Wendico

Wendico KLG is a digital studio in Thalheim an der Thur, Zurich Weinland, Switzerland.

Website: https://wendico.ch
Contact: info@wendico.ch
Phone: +41 79 504 10 05
Location: Im Hofacker 3, 8478 Thalheim an der Thur, Switzerland

Core services:
- Webauftritt Erstellung: custom websites, web design, responsive development, SEO basics, Google business setup.
- Social Media Management: content planning, social media formats, brand communication.
- Umsatzsystem: digital systems that turn visitors into inquiries, bookings, leads and revenue.

Management:
- Panat Ruangsri: Sales, Strategie, Webdesign
- Tim Biedermann: Finance, Strategie, Design

Main pages:

Positioning:
Wendico builds individual websites and digital systems for companies, brands, restaurants, services, events, beauty businesses and portfolios in Switzerland. The focus is clarity, trust, conversion, ownership after completion and no plugin dependency.
